name: Ash-Lad
description: The youngest brother, dismissed as an ash-poker, who wins favor through hard work and triumphs through quick thinking, bold improvisation, and a stubbornly hopeful spirit.
visualPrompt: A lean, bright-eyed young man with tousled hair and a humble servant’s outfit, carrying a small pouch of grain and later a shining gold harp; practical and unassuming, with an alert, mischievous expression that suggests clever plans forming

name: The Troll
description: A powerful, lake-side mountain troll whose treasured silver ducks, bedspread, and gold harp are stolen, driving it to rage and revenge.
visualPrompt: A massive, rough-skinned troll with heavy limbs and a broad, grim face, looming near the shore by a dark mountain cave; its presence feels ancient and dangerous, with wild fury in its eyes

name: The Troll’s Daughter
description: The troll’s willing helper who tends the fattening-stall and prepares to slaughter Ash-Lad, until he turns her own knife-trick against her.
visualPrompt: A formidable troll-woman with thick braids and strong features, wearing coarse mountain-cloth and a grim, practical expression; she carries a long knife and moves with blunt confidence

name: The King
description: A ruler who desires the troll’s marvels and forces Ash-Lad into dangerous tasks, then rewards him with the princess and half the kingdom.
visualPrompt: A stern, middle-aged king in a fur-trimmed cloak and simple crown, seated in a rustic manor hall; his expression is demanding yet impressed, surrounded by the warm glow of a hearth

name: Ash-Lad’s Two Elder Brothers
description: Jealous siblings who mock Ash-Lad and repeatedly provoke the King into sending him on perilous errands, only to be met with his surprising generosity at the end.
visualPrompt: Two young men in worn stable-and-garden work clothes, one with a sour frown and the other with a calculating stare; they stand slightly apart from others, their posture tense with envy
